name: Albanian Sign Language
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

earlier_scan.note: Sign language; Hoyer 2005/2007 sociolinguistic reports exist but word stress is inapplicable and no prosodic description found.

sources.citation: Glottolog 5.x languoid page alba1271 and hh.bib entries tagged [sqk]; Ethnologue 28 (2025) record 701778.
sources.note: Glottolog lists no descriptive (grammar/phonology/sketch) reference for AlbSL: only Hoyer 2005 wordlist, Hoyer 2007 minimal/socling, Hoyer 2012 socling, Quer 2016 and Ethnologue overviews, ISO request.

sources.citation: Kisi, Anida; Toro, Elona; Spahi, Nikoleta. 2026. Linguistic Standardization and the Training of Interpreters in Albanian Sign Language: Challenges of an Emerging Field. XLinguae 19(2): 60-69. DOI 10.18355/XL.2026.19.02.04
sources.note: Language-policy article; documents the 2005 dictionary (264 entries), the 2017 online dictionary (895 units, >300 added 2019-2025). No phonology, no stress.

sources.citation: ANAD (Shoqata Kombëtare Shqiptare e Njerëzve që nuk Dëgjojnë). 2017-. Gramatika e gjuhës së shenjave: Struktura e shenjës. Gjuha e Shenjave Shqipe (online dictionary and grammar), https://gjshsh.al/gramatika/struktura-e-shenjes/
sources.note: The only AlbSL-specific phonological sketch found: signs consist of five meaningless formational elements (handshape, location, movement, orientation, non-manual features) illustrated with AlbSL minimal pairs (vëllai/motra, e di/kundër, drejtë/thikë/gjysëm, faleminderit/më fal). No mention of stress, prosody, rhythm, lengthening or prominence (grep theks/prozod/ritm/intonac: none).

sources.citation: ANAD. 2017-. Lëvizja dhe gjestikulacionet e gojës (mouthings and mouth gestures). https://gjshsh.al/gramatika/levizja-dhe-gjestikulacionet-e-gojes/
sources.note: Mouth actions as a non-manual parameter (three types: full mouthing, partial mouthing, mouth gesture). Nothing on stress or prosody.

sources.citation: Hoyer, Karin. 2012. Dokumentation och beskrivning som språkplanering – perspektiv från arbete med tre tecknade minoritetsspråk. Nordica Helsingensia 29. PhD dissertation, Helsingfors universitet. 136 pp. (summary volume) + Studie D (46 pp.).
sources.note: Nothing. Sociolinguistic/lexicographic study of dictionary work in Finland-Swedish, Albanian and Kosovar SL; grep for betoning/prosodi/fonologi/accent finds only general remarks; no description of AlbSL sign structure, stress or prosody. Summarises Hoyer 2007 (Studie C) as 'the first scientific study of Albanian Sign Language ever', a language-contact study (p. 73-74 of the summary).

sources.citation: ISO 639-3 Registration Authority. 2011. Change Request 2011-012 and New Code Request sqk (submitted by ANAD with K. Hoyer and R. Skinner; adopted 2012-02-03).
sources.note: Nothing on structure beyond 'heavy use of fingerspelling' and contact with International Sign. Lists as the only published sources ANAD 2005 'Gjuha e Shenjave Shqipe 1' (247 entries, ISBN 99943-701-6-2) and Hoyer 2007.

sources.citation: ANAD. 2017-. Situata me gjuhën e kontaktit të gjuhës së shenjave shqipe (Albanian summary of Hoyer 2007). https://gjshsh.al/gramatika/situata-me-gjuhen-e-kontaktit-te-gjuhes-se-shenjave-shqipe/
sources.note: Language contact (fingerspelling, hearing gestures, 1996 'Libër me shenja', International Sign). Nothing on stress; the only prosody-adjacent remark is that the AlbSL sign SHTETI has a doubled downward movement vs. the IS form.

sources.citation: Lahtinen, Inkeri & Rainò, Päivi. 2016. Deaf People in Albania 2015: A survey study. Helsinki: Finnish Association of the Deaf. ISBN 978-952-5396-76-8.
sources.tag: wanted: likely states stress, not held
sources.note: Sociolinguistic survey cited by gjshsh.al and Kisi et al. 2026; background only, no phonology expected.

sources.citation: Quer, Josep. 2016. Sign language: Southern Europe. SAGE Deaf Studies Encyclopedia, 817-819.
